meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查电脑上 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装是否正常,与最新官方源码对比,给出「通过/警告/失败」分级报告,每条结论都附命令输出或文件证据;它只诊断,不改动你的配置或安装。
howto.when: 当你说「做个体检/健康检查」、提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等词,或安装、升级、改配置后 Codex 表现异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康
say.note: 会对比最新源码并给出分级报告

say.text: 升级后 Codex 表现异常,帮我诊断
say.note: 核对配置、插件和运行时状态

say.text: 我的 Codex 可能过期了,帮忙查查
say.note: 与最新版本对比,列出需要修复项

howto.what_en: Audits the local LazyCodex/Codex install against latest sources; returns PASS/WARN/FAIL with each verdict citing evidence. Diagnosis only, no writes to config, install, or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a doctor or health check, mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or reports Codex misbehaving after an install, update, or config change, or suspects a stale or broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy
say_en.note: Runs the doctor and returns a verdict report

say_en.text: Codex is acting up after an update, diagnose it
say_en.note: Verifies config, plugins, and runtime probe

say_en.text: My Codex setup may be stale, please audit it
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources and lists fixes
